facts.detail: The May 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
Reported built premises fell for two contracts because suppliers resubmitted administrative data.
The page says those revisions reflect administrative-data updates rather than changed delivery performance.
Users are told to exercise caution when comparing the affected contracts with earlier publications.
The release reports monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress.
The contracted premises field covers initial scope only and may omit deferred scope.
CO denotes Type C Call Off contracts.
The management-information figures are not directly comparable with BDUK official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 21 May 2026.
The May table totals 837,340 contracted premises and 256,680 built contracted premises.

facts.detail: The June 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
The page reports monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress.
Contracted premises figures include only initial scope and may exclude deferred scope.
CO is defined as Type C Call Off contract.
The release is not directly comparable with subsidy-attributable official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 17 June 2026.
The page warns of a variable lag between signature or delivery and ingestion.
The June data is rounded to the nearest 10 and totals may not sum exactly.
The June table includes CO8 Cheshire with 18,460 contracted premises and zero built contracted premises.
The June table totals 839,340 contracted premises and 271,460 built contracted premises.
